refutes.statement: Conjecture DL2 (k4/strategy.md §3): every min-frozen P with def(P) > 0 has a min-frozen P' with def(P') < def(P) whose bases differ from P's for at most two agents. Here f = 0 (Theorem Z's case) and the only repairs rotate a 3-cycle of exposures; the first DL2 counterexample is dl2-n3m7 of proof/k4-dl2-k1 (f = 1, role swap plus release)

notes: Found by k4/dl2.c (compute/k4-dl2) on random strict profiles of the n = 3 cores and confirmed by k4/suite/deficit_local.py (model.py) and by attempts/k4_dl2_rotation.py (raw re-derivation). f = 0, omega = 1, 36 min-frozen P (all need-free); P = ({0,6},{3,5},{2,4}) has def 1 and every other min-frozen P differs from it in all three bases (P is isolated). Smallest f = 0 failure (f = 0 with omega >= 1 needs m >= 2n + 1 = 7).
